findings.summary: The bespoke `Summary` card reimplements MetricCard (label/value/icon) instead of reusing the shared primitive, diverging in typography (text-2xl vs metric-card's text-3xl) and icon treatment (plain text-brand icon vs metric-icon badge).
findings.fix: Delete the local `Summary` component and import `MetricCard` from '../../ui/MetricCard', rendering the summary section with `<MetricCard label="الأدوار" value={data.roles.length} icon={ShieldCheck} />` etc.

findings.summary:
The loading state is a bare `

` text line rather than the app's LoadingScreen/spinner + skeleton pattern, giving an inconsistent, unpolished loading experience for this heavy catalog page.
findings.fix:
Replace the `

` with the shared `LoadingScreen` (`import { LoadingScreen } from '../../ui/LoadingScreen'`) or a card-based skeleton matching the pattern used in KpiEvaluationEditor (`

`).

findings.summary: The error path renders `EmptyState` for a load FAILURE, but the app convention for errors is a red alert banner (role="alert") as in EmployeesPage/CreateEmployeePage; EmptyState is meant for 'no data', not failures.
findings.fix:
Replace the EmptyState with the standard error banner: `
تعذر تحميل الصلاحيات: {query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : 'غير مصرح'}
`.

findings.summary: The module-filter `<select>` (كل الوحدات) inside the role dialog has no accessible label — it is a bare select with no aria-label or associated <label>.
findings.fix: Add `aria-label="تصفية حسب الوحدة"` to the `<select className="input max-w-xs">`, or wrap it in the shared `Select` helper which renders a visible label.

findings.summary: The role-revoke mutation (commands.revokeRole) has no error surfacing; if the delete fails the UI silently ignores it, unlike other mutations on sibling pages (e.g. OperationsCenterPage) that render a red error banner.
findings.fix:
Surface `commands.revokeRole.isError` with the standard `

` banner, mirroring OperationsCenterPage/LiveLocationPage error handling.

findings.summary: The role-remove trash button uses the hardcoded Tailwind `text-red-600` instead of the danger design token, so it won't adapt to the dark theme's --danger value.
findings.fix: Replace `className="text-red-600"` with `className="text-[var(--danger)]"` (or a shared danger utility) to stay token-driven and dark-theme correct.

findings.summary: The Dialog overlay uses a hardcoded `bg-slate-950/60` scrim rather than a design token, matching a known inconsistency (same literal in LearningPage) instead of a theme-aware overlay.
findings.fix: Use a token-based scrim such as `bg-[var(--text-primary)]/50` or a shared overlay class so the modal backdrop respects the theme system.

findings.summary: The permissions module filter is a lone select with no result count or clear affordance, inconsistent with the FilterBar pattern (resultText + مسح الكل) used across filterable lists in the app.
findings.fix:
Show a live result count near the filter (e.g. `

{filteredCount} صلاحية

`) and reset moduleFilter to 'all' on dialog open for a consistent filtering UX.
